4464624884.desc:
Spotify's mission is to unlock the potential of human creativity by giving a million creative artists the opportunity to live off their art and billions of fans the chance to enjoy and be passionate about these creators.
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify's subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.
This role focuses on the awareness, acquisition, and activation layers of the Subscriptions Mission, making Premium feel unmissable to free users long before a purchase decision. You'll own the strategy for how users discover, understand, and develop intent for Premium value, partnering closely with product, design, engineering, research, marketing, and data science to shape the moments, surfaces, and experiences that drive consideration across markets and segments.
What You Will Do
 Own the product strategy and roadmap for Premium awareness, acquisition, and activation, helping more listeners discover its value and take the next step toward subscribing.
 Lead the discovery, development, and launch of consumer-facing product experiences, from early ideas and testing through to global rollout.
 Shape how people experience Premium across Spotify and partner channels, creating engaging journeys that build consideration, encourage subscription, and support long-term retention.
 Collaborate with partnerships and commercial teams to develop, launch, and scale subscription offerings across partners, markets, and audience segments.
 Lead experimentation to understand what drives interest in Premium, using A/B testing and behavioral insights to improve the user journey and measure business impact.
 Turn customer insights, market trends, and performance data into clear product opportunities, measurable goals, and informed priorities.
 Balance user needs, business outcomes, partner requirements, and regional differences to make thoughtful product decisions that deliver sustainable growth.
 Bring teams together around a shared direction, communicating product strategy, results, and trade-offs clearly to stakeholders and senior leaders.
 Where You'll Be
 You have a strong track record in product management, building and launching consumer-facing products at scale, with experience in areas such as subscriptions, consumer growth, marketplaces, media, or partner ecosystems.
 You understand what makes a product valuable to consumers and how product experiences, positioning, and messaging influence consideration and willingness to pay.
 You know how to identify opportunities across the customer journey, from awareness and acquisition through conversion and retention, and connect product decisions to subscriber and revenue growth.
 You're confident designing experiments, interpreting A/B tests, and using funnel, cohort, and behavioral data to make informed product decisions.
 You have experience working across different markets and customer segments, balancing globally consistent experiences with local needs and opportunities.
 You bring sound product judgment, knowing when to improve an existing experience, explore a new approach, or invest in longer-term capabilities.
 You're a thoughtful communicator and collaborative partner who can bring together diverse perspectives, influence

4464630796.desc:
The Subscriptions Mission builds and evolves Spotify’s subscription products and marketplace experiences to drive sustainable user and revenue growth globally. We focus on awareness, acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization strategies that help users unlock the full value of Spotify while enabling the business to scale efficiently and responsibly.
Spotify's Customer Service Platform powers interactions between our users and support teams. As a Product Manager, you will shape the tools, channels, and foundational APIs that enable our advisors to deliver fast, effective, and empathetic support at scale.
You’ll help improve the advisor experience through intelligent tooling, define how customers reach support across channels, and strengthen the API layer underpinning our service ecosystem. Your work will bring platform thinking together with real human impact, helping our advisors do their best work and improving how users experience Spotify support.
What You'll Do
 Own the product vision and roadmap for the tools our support advisors use every day, improving efficiency and enabling better outcomes for users.
 Define and evolve how customers access support across chat, email, social messaging, and emerging channels, helping the right contact reach the right advisor at the right time.
 Strengthen the foundational API layer connecting our support systems, with a focus on reliability, extensibility, and developer experience as the platform scales.
 Take initiatives from discovery through launch, partnering closely with engineering to ship iteratively, learn quickly, and deliver meaningful outcomes.
 Identify opportunities to thoughtfully apply AI and automation within advisor workflows and channel routing to improve speed, accuracy, and the advisor experience.
 Collaborate with engineering, design, data science, and customer service operations to build scalable capabilities that serve both advisors and users.
 Define meaningful success metrics, run experiments, and use data and customer insights to make clear prioritisation decisions and measure impact.
 Who You Are
 You have 4+ years of product management experience and a track record of delivering impactful products in technology-driven environments.
 You think in systems and understand how APIs, integrations, platforms, and tooling can work together to create leverage across an organisation.
 You are comfortable partnering with engineering teams on API design, system architecture, and technical trade-offs; you don't need to write code, but you can engage confidently in technical conversations.
 You know how to take products from discovery through delivery, balancing thoughtful product development with the pace needed to learn and make progress.
 You are curious about customer service and support operations and bring empathy for both the people providing support and the users receiving it.
 You communicate clearly, can make complex trade-offs understandable, and know how to create alignment across technical and non-technical partners.
 You use data, experimentation, customer insight, and judgement to make decisions and are comfortable adapting when you learn something new.
 You enjoy working collaboratively across disciplines and care about building products that create meaningful outcomes for customers and the people who support them.
 Where You'll Be
 This role is based in London, UK.

About Us
 GoCardless, a Mollie company, is a global leader in bank payments. Over 100,000 businesses, from start-ups to household names, use GoCardless to collect, manage and send bank payments through Direct Debit, real-time payments and open banking. With US$130bn+ processed annually across 30+ countries, we handle recurring and one-off payments without the chasing, stress, or expensive fees. Our end-to-end payment platform also features AI-powered solutions to improve payment success and reduce fraud, alongside connections to over 350 platforms businesses use everyday.
We are headquartered in the UK, with teams and operations spanning North America, Europe and Asia-Pacific. For more information, please visit www.gocardless.com and follow us on LinkedIn @GoCardless.
Mollie is the leading payments and financial services partner for business, rooted in Europe, with global reach.
 The role
 This role sits within the Merchant Risk Monitoring team in our Merchant Operations Group. The team is responsible for the core systems that manage our in-life merchant risk management. These systems ensure that we meet our compliance obligations and stay within our risk appetite as a business.
In this role, you will work closely with engineers to drive product improvements that strengthen our controls whilst continuing to provide a good customer experience. You will also collaborate with teams across the organisation to ensure our capabilities scale with the needs of both customers and the business. This is a fixed-term contract role for 12 months.
 What Excites You
 Delivering customer and business value: Being relentlessly focused on understanding and solving the customer problems which result in them using GoCardless as much as they can. Problem discovery and prioritisation: Taking complex and ambiguous product problems and structuring these effectively. This includes clearly defining the problem space, the impact of the problem and your prioritisation process. Data-led decision-making: Using quantitative and qualitative evidence to support your decisions and opportunity identification. Contributing to Product Strategy: Identifying key customer segments, and our approach to meeting their needs over the longer term in ways that create value for them and GoCardless Influencing and communication: Building collaborative relationships with your team, stakeholders and executives to deliver change effectively across your remit. This includes growing to become the ‘go-to’ person for your product area; translating complex, technical problems into understandable concepts; and convincing stakeholders of the best approach using structured reasoning. Leadership: Setting direction and coordinating action across a range of teams and functions Shipping stuff: Working with your team to support changes to completion, delivering consistent positive impact across your product area. Being comfortable delivering a range of projects: from MVP experiments testing a hypothesis to a new feature.
 What Excites Us
 Delivery of impact: You are focused on delivering business value through experimentation and have experience of doing that.
 Exceptional problem-solving and analytical skills: We want our Product Managers to have an outstanding ability to tackle valuable customer and business problems. At GoCardless we start by asking ‘why?’, and a data-led approach is central to how we run Product. You have a customer centric approach and are comfortable with qualitative and quant

4482138738.desc:
Join us as Staff Product Manager, Accounting Europe to make accounting simple for SMEs and accountants, whatever their setup. You'll start with Germany, then take what works to other European markets, under the guidance of Paul Mourot, our Head of Product for Accounting.
➡️ What you'll do
 Fix a broken experience: You'll build an accounting page that surfaces our existing building blocks and integrations, starting with Connect.
 Live with our customers: You'll spend your time with SMEs, accountants and tax advisors to understand their habits and needs.
 Assemble before you build: You'll combine existing building blocks to deliver value fast, and shape what we build next.
 Define the long-term vision: You'll set the product direction for accounting in Germany, using AI to prototype and test ideas early.
 Scale across Europe: You'll adapt the offer to each market and to every segment, from small businesses to SMEs and accountants.
 ➡️ What we're looking for
 German fluency: You speak German natively and have strong English, so you can work with local customers and Qonto's European teams.
 Customer obsession: You learn by talking to users, and you turn what you hear into product decisions.
 Proven scale: You've taken a product from 0 to 1 or significantly scaled it, and you think in outcomes, not features.
 Systems thinking: You can see which existing pieces to reuse and which to build, then make the trade-offs.
 AI-native workflow: You use AI to speed up research, specs and prototyping, and you see it as a product lever.
 ➡️ What we can offer you
 Local expertise on tap: Tax advisors who know the German market will support you, so you don't need to be an accountant.
 A head start: You start with a live tax advisor marketplace and a proven French bookkeeping engine.
 Real scope: You own accounting for every European market outside France, across segments.
 Autonomy and AI tools: Your squad owns its roadmap and ships without red tape, with unlimited access to the best AI tools.
 ➡️ Your future manager
You'll report to Paul Mourot, Head of Product for Accounting, who gives his PMs real ownership. Paul was CPO and co-founder at Semana, Head of Product at BCG Digital Ventures, and CPO at Tiime, an accounting-tech platform. He joined Qonto in 2025 to build the accounting product line, and he hires great people, gives them support, context and autonomy.

At New Relic, we build an intelligent platform that empowers companies to thrive in an AI-first world by giving them unparalleled insight into their complex systems. As we continue to expand our global footprint, we're looking for passionate people to join our mission. If you're ready to help the world's best companies optimize their digital applications, we invite you to explore a career with us!
Your Opportunity
Are you passionate about building foundational technology that fuels the world’s digital innovation? At New Relic, we provide the leading unified data platform for all things observability – helping engineers, developers, and operators make decisions using data at every stage of the software lifecycle. Our New Relic Control team is at the heart of that mission, creating groundbreaking capabilities that orchestrate, manage, and optimize observability agents and telemetry pipelines at scale.
We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead a new strategic initiative within our Pipeline Control team. In this role, you’ll be responsible for defining vision, strategy, and roadmap for an enterprise-grade solution that orchestrates observability pipelines to streamline telemetry data in flight. You'll collaborate closely with engineering and product design to solve complex challenges around instrumentation, configuration, and data management with new systems and experiences. If you love turning ambitious ideas into impactful enterprise products that delight customers, let's talk!

 Define and drive the product strategy for our next-generation observability pipelines solution and align your vision with broader company goals
 Lead cross-functional collaboration with Engineering, Product Design, Sales, and Marketing to translate customer insights and technical opportunities into impactful product capabilities
 Evangelize the product vision internally and externally, providing thought leadership on how modern observability practices can transform DevOps efficiency and drive customer value
 Engage deeply in technical design discussions around distributed systems, client-server architectures, cloud native stacks, OpenTelemetry, and advanced instrumentation workflows, leveraging your strong engineering or equivalent background
 Steer end-to-end product development from concept through launch, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery, continuous iteration, and measurable business success
 Champion product excellence by setting high standards for design, user experience, security, and performance while addressing complex enterprise needs at scale
 Coach and influence the broader product and engineering teams as a subject-matter expert with clear priorities, measurable goals, and unwavering focus on customer success
